facts.fact: The historic centre combines architectural periods and a grid adapted to slopes; the Morelian Baroque description concerns the ensemble rather than a single uniformly colonial construction date.

facts.fact: The city was formerly Valladolid and was renamed Morelia in 1828 in honour of José María Morelos. This context is not a current tourism-event claim.
